tldr: Mercury in the 12th house routes the mind and voice through the hidden inner life.
body: With Mercury in the 12th house, thinking, speech, learning, writing, business, and the way the mind makes connections move through solitude, rest, hidden patterns, dreams, release, and spiritual repair. This makes how you meet what is private, unconscious, unfinished, or ready to be released a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening. Left unconscious, it can become overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it.
gift: language, strategy, adaptability, problem-solving, and the ability to name what is happening expressed through the hidden inner life.
challenge: overthinking, nervous loops, clever avoidance, or talking around the feeling instead of entering it concentrated in the hidden inner life.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
